PERSONAL PROJECTS + CLOUD LABS

Understand who can reach what.

I model identities, policies and access paths to examine how permission changes affect a system.

  • Review AWS-style IAM conditions, role relationships and before-and-after access.
  • Practise least privilege, identity life cycles, RBAC/ABAC and MFA.
  • Review S3 public-access risks, encryption, bucket policies and audit controls.
AWS IAM / S3 fundamentalsPolicy modellingRBAC / ABACLeast privilegeMFA
SEE THE WORKREVOCASCOPE · synthetic IAM investigations

AUTHORISED LAB PRACTICE

Follow the traffic. Check the evidence.

I use networking and operating-system fundamentals to investigate activity and document what the evidence supports.

  • Inspect Wireshark captures, DNS, TCP handshakes, HTTP, ports and controlled Nmap scans.
  • Practise Linux users, groups, permissions, SSH and system/service log inspection.
  • Check phishing headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, SHA-256 integrity, incident notes and risk controls.
WiresharkNmapTCP/IP · DNS · DHCPTLS basics · SSHUbuntu / Kali / macOSPhishing analysisSHA-256
